search_text: published ZDI-18-068 ZDI-CAN-5121 Trend Micro Control Manager AdHocQuery_Processor ProductLogQuery SQL Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2018-01-10 CVE-2018-3602 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2018-3602 6.0 ['Trend Micro'] ['Control Manager'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Trend Micro Control Manager. Although authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability, the existing authentication mechanism can be bypassed. The specific flaw exists within the GetProductCategory method, which is called by the AdHocQuery_Processor servlet. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it to construct SQL queries. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code under the context of the Network Service account. Trend Micro has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. title: Trend Micro Control Manager AdHocQuery_Processor ProductLogQuery SQL Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Trend Micro Control Manager. Although authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability, the existing authentication mechanism can be bypassed. The specific flaw exists within the GetProductCategory method, which is called by the AdHocQuery_Processor servlet. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it to construct SQL queries. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code under the context of the Network Service account.
